description: Peripheral (and, in the future, other requirement-category) blocks for one profile. The UI renders this array generically -- adding a new block, or a new detail field within an existing block, requires only a JSON change, never a page-generator code change.

id.description: Stable slug, e.g. "wan". Unique within a profile's array.

title.description: Display heading for this block, e.g. "WAN".

requirement.description: The generic, chip-agnostic requirement -- what any compatible device must provide, not tied to a specific component. Empty string if this block is not applicable to the profile.

group.description: Which of the spec's 9 requirement categories this block belongs to. Today only "peripherals" is populated; the same array shape is intended to carry the other categories to the UI later without a schema change.

order.description: Display order within its group, ascending.

statusPills.description: One or more status pills shown in the block header. Empty array if this block has no top-level status (rare).

label.description: Pill prefix label, e.g. "Web UI". Null for an unlabeled primary pill.

detail.description: Ordered list of label/value detail lines shown in the block body.

value.description: A string, a list of strings, or (rarely) a nested list of detail items.

referenceImplementation.description: Optional. The specific component used on the reference device (e.g. "BPI-R4: Silicon Labs EFR32xG24") that satisfies the requirement above. An example of one implementation, not a mandate -- other compatible hardware may satisfy the same requirement with a different component.

crossRef.description: Optional. Requirement IDs (e.g. ["PER-001", "NET-002"]) this block is backed by, so detail isn't duplicated between the peripherals view and the full requirement tables.

notes.description: Free-text note. Empty string if none.
